depth: dot(surface-center,towardCamera)/radius; valid only where colour coverage > 0

adapter.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (0x00002B85) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

limitations: Capture only: runtime impostor, parallax, handoff and game integration are pending
Mips preserve mean area coverage; they require coverage-aware runtime rendering, not a fixed MASK threshold
Depth is the frontmost covered subsample; normal/classification and colour average coverage and can mix disconnected surfaces
RGBA32F capture files are review data, not compressed shipping textures

files.albedo: 8-bit sRGB RGB; linear area coverage in alpha; top row first in PNG (flipped from raw readback)
files.colour: little-endian Float32 RGBA, linear RGB/coverage, bottom row first
files.data: little-endian Float32 RGBA, normal XYZ / normalized view-axis depth, bottom row first
files.classification: little-endian Float32 R, leaf fraction, bottom row first

mipPolicy: Mean area coverage, coverage-weighted linear RGB/vector normal/classification, frontmost covered depth; each view reduced independently then four-texel RGB/data padding without alpha growth
